description:
Search lobbying disclosure filings — find out who is lobbying Congress, on what issues, and how much they're spending.

Search by:
- registrant_name: lobbying firm or self-filing org ('Pfizer', 'Amazon', 'National Rifle Association')
- client_name: who hired the lobbyist ('Google', 'ExxonMobil')
- issue_code: policy area ('TAX', 'HCR' health, 'DEF' defense, 'ENV' environment, 'ENG' energy, 'IMM' immigration). Requires registrant_name or client_name: the LDA API can't filter by issue, so up to 200 of that registrant's/client's filings are scanned and the total number of matches may be unknown.
- filing_year: year of filing (2020-2026)
- More filters: lobbyist_name, lobbyist_covered_position (former government job of a listed lobbyist, e.g. 'Chief of Staff'; needs registrant_name, client_name or lobbyist_name, since that search is slow otherwise), specific_issues (text of the issues lobbied, e.g. 'semiconductor'), foreign_entity_name / foreign_entity_country (foreign interests, e.g. 'CN'), client_state, amount_min / amount_max (income or expenses reported, USD), posted_after / posted_before (YYYY-MM-DD), filing_period.

Returns expenses/income amounts, issues lobbied, and registrant/client info.

amount_max.description: Maximum income or expenses reported, in dollars

amount_min.description: Minimum income or expenses reported, in dollars

filing_type.description: Filing type: 'Q1' (1st Quarter Report), 'Q2' (2nd Quarter Report), 'Q3' (3rd Quarter Report), 'Q4' (4th Quarter Report), 'MM' (Mid-Year Report), 'MY' (Year-End Report), 'RN' (Registration (New)), 'RA' (Registration Amendment), 'RR' (Registration Renewal), 'TE' (Termination)

foreign_entity_country.description: Two-letter country code of a foreign entity: 'CN', 'JP', 'DE'

foreign_entity_name.description: Foreign entity with an interest in the lobbying: 'Airbus'

issue_code.description: Issue area code (requires registrant_name or client_name): 'HCR' (Health Issues), 'MMM' (Medicare/Medicaid), 'TAX' (Taxation/Internal Revenue Code), 'BUD' (Budget/Appropriations), 'DEF' (Defense), 'ENV' (Environment/Superfund), 'ENG' (Energy/Nuclear), 'TRD' (Trade (Domestic/Foreign)), ... (20 total)

lobbyist_covered_position.description: Former government position of a listed lobbyist (text search): 'Chief of Staff', 'Senator', 'Legislative Director'. Needs registrant_name, client_name or lobbyist_name.

lobbyist_name.description: A lobbyist listed on the filing: 'Smith'

registrant_name.description: Lobbying firm or organization: 'Pfizer', 'Amazon', 'US Chamber of Commerce'

specific_issues.description: Text of the specific issues lobbied (text search): 'semiconductor', 'H.R. 4346'

name: lobbying_search
